::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[I need help to determine the $\lim_{x\to0^-} \frac{x^2\sin(1/x)}{\sin(x)}$?](https://math.stackexchange.com/questions/3411312/i-need-help-to-determine-the-lim-x-to0-fracx2-sin1-x-sinx), asked by [SFR](https://math.stackexchange.com/users/580002/sfr) on Mathematics Stack Exchange (2019-10-27; [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)):

> I need help determining the following limit:
>
> $$\lim_{x\to0^-} \frac{x^2\sin(1/x)}{\sin(x)}$$
:::

Write the function as
$$\frac{x^2 \sin(1/x)}{\sin x} = \frac{x}{\sin x} \cdot x \sin\frac{1}{x}$$
and take the limit of each factor.
